main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean next-bar return minus coin mean, on bars with forecast < 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm if negative with t <= -2; reject if positive with t >= +2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: binomial z, share of down next bars, active minus all

decided_by: Inconclusive: t lies strictly between -2 and +2.
reading: Coin mean is the mean next-bar return pooled over all bars of all windows; the weighted t uses SE = sqrt(sum w^2 (x-m)^2)/sum w * sqrt(n/(n-1)); a stretch is a run of raw SMA spread < 0 inside a window containing at least one forecast < 0 bar; a down bar is a negative next-bar return, and the supporting check passes at z >= 2.
